H_protocol: H1 literal source-compatible acts; H2 actual amplification with intensity limits; H3 behavior too local-punchline-bound to generalize; H4 actual nonliteral behavioral license. L_protocol: L0 portable proposition; L1 material wording/rhythm/tone; L2 pragmatics/register/recipient force; L3 central Japanese form requiring reconstruction or annotation. An idiom, cultural formula, ruby, name error or magical word alone does not establish L3.
